summary: Full stack testing of ALIENS V A.I. MVP. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests pass — player init/get, robot CRUD with computed stats, threats generation, battle simulation with player XP/score persistence, leaderboard ordering by score desc, and AI briefing via Gemini 3 Flash (EMERGENT_LLM_KEY) all working. Frontend: Boot screen with brand + terminal + codename input works; activation navigates to Command Center; Command tab renders threat cards + ENGAGE buttons; Builder tab renders category chips, parts grid, stat bars, name input; Leaderboard tab shows ranked players including the just-activated TESTER-FE. One testID deviation from spec found.

ui_bugs.issue: Spec expected a 'MANUFACTURE UNIT' button with testID='manufacture-button' but actual testID is 'save-robot-button'. Rename to 'manufacture-button' to match the review request, or update spec.

react_native_issues.issue: Warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' appears repeatedly in console. Non-blocking but should be migrated.

action_items: Optionally rename testID 'save-robot-button' -> 'manufacture-button' in app/(tabs)/builder.tsx to align with review spec.
Migrate deprecated props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to silence RN web warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is defined AFTER ai_brief() references it in the except block (logger.exception). If AI call fails on first import ordering, logger.exception would work only because logging.basicConfig is called at module load and logger is set at bottom before app is served — currently fine, but the reference-before-assignment style is fragile. Move logger init to top of file.
server.py: uses @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI — prefer lifespan handler.

simulate_battle uses random.randint without seed — battle results non-deterministic across retries which is acceptable for gameplay but not for reproducible tests. Consider seeding per battle for replay debugging.
player init endpoint accepts any codename with no length/charset validation server-side (frontend enforces >=2 chars). Add Pydantic validator to prevent empty/malicious codenames.
leaderboard endpoint has no pagination cursor — fine for MVP.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested flows verified except in-session end-to-end combat replay assertion due to per-script browser storage isolation; individual pieces confirmed to render/click)

seed_data_creation: Created player 'TESTER-BE' (backend, currently rank #1 with score 210 after battle test) and 'TESTER-FE' (frontend activation, rank #4 with 0 score). One robot TEST_ORION created & auto-deleted by test fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend must be tested in a single browser session because each mcp_browser_automation call spawns fresh localStorage. Boot flow -> activate -> then in the SAME script navigate through builder/fleet/combat using in-app buttons rather than page.goto. Save-robot button testID is 'save-robot-button'. Category chips are 'cat-<category>' and parts are 'part-<key>'. Combat screen uses testIDs: 'scan-button', 'ai-briefing', 'select-robot-<id>', 'engage-button', 'battle-result'.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Only naming inconsistency between spec ('MANUFACTURE UNIT' testID='manufacture-button') and implementation (testID='save-robot-button'). Button itself works correctly.
